_about: Business rules applied on top of the learned models when a charge line is categorised. The first matching rule wins; a correction made in the review screen (a learned alias) always overrides a rule. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tested against the charge description. Edit 'field' to send that kind of line somewhere else, or set 'review' to true to have every such line checked by a person. A rule may carry 'regions' (EU, US, CA, UK, OTHER): it then applies only when the invoice's destination is in one of them.

rules.name: delivery-haulage
rules.why: Haulage on the delivery (destination) side is a delivered-at-place cost, not pre-carriage.

rules.name: combined-security-filing
rules.why: One line names advance-manifest filings for different regions (EU: ENS / ICS2 and US or Canada: AMS / ISF / ACD); it is booked under AMS and flagged because the invoice itself does not say which one applies.
